security_concerns.issue: The exact-endpoint guard validates URL hostname/port/username, but passes its unchecked query parameters to pg.Client for the admin connection. Installed pg-connection-string/index.js:40-64 explicitly lets query parameters override host, port and user. Thus an otherwise allowed CI URL with ?host=another-host&port=5432 passes this guard and can CREATE DATABASE on a different cluster. The local branch also connects before checking data_directory. Clearing url.search at line 59 happens after the admin connection and CREATE DATABASE, so it is too late.
security_concerns.recommendation: Fail closed before connecting: reject query parameters and non-PostgreSQL protocols, or construct the admin connection from explicitly validated connection fields without forwarding arbitrary URL options. Add negative guard cases for host/port/user query overrides. Please resolve this before approving the fixture guard.
